item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Not sure why everyone is having such a hard time with this. I thought this was awesome, and remind me of (I believe) an old Gaelic mythology tale? What do you guys not find anomalous, or even scary, about being consciously trapped inside a tree? Have another +1 Hippo.

IU: Why aren't we experimenting on these things? There are a grove of them? Let's cut into one, carefully of course. Are tests being done to see if these individuals can be recovered and, if the body-snatching is to be believed by The Foundation, why are we not looking for the aged individuals who may just be puppets walking among us? I'd like just a bit more of this.

item.title: Re: Question
item.content:encoded: Wait, you mean the PoI's were apart of the trees? I know all of the "show, don't tell" stuff, and "leave it to the imagination", but I really would have like that to be made clear while I read through the actual SCP.

item.title: Re: Question
item.content:encoded:
Something was trapped inside the trees. In the Summer of '91 — while a bunch of kids were attending the camp — that something got out. It forced the kids to take their place (trapping them inside of the trees), took their forms, and escaped.

Judging by the final email, it seems likely that the children who ended up trapped inside of those trees are, in fact, still conscious.

item.title: Question
item.content:encoded:
What is the main basic synopsis of this scp? What happened to the kids? Who took over their bodies?

Here's what I know so far. All the kids at the camp turned into trees. Then someone took over the kids original bodies. I know that much. But who took over their bodies? Did the trees replace them? Also, are the kids within the trees conscious? Can you talk to them? Can they speak?

Maybe the kids were turned into trees by the camp counselors. Then the tree's gave birth to human clones of the kids. Then those clones went off, and took over the life of the kid. Body snatching.

Who did this though? Who took over their bodies? That is the question…

Am I correct though? Is this a good run down, or did I miss anything? Can someone explain this SCP better?

item.title: Author's Post
item.content:encoded:
Take me to that summer past
And tell me is it really worth remembering?

I realize that music then
Was really just a song inside my head

And though the fun has passed
Those mythic dreams were meant to last
Have no fear anymore
